PROPOSE·activity.label: Proposing a plan
PROPOSE·activity.def: do something together with the sender
PROPOSE·activity.cues: first-person plural incl. both + activity verb + future/time (我们去, 要不要一起, let's)
PROPOSE·activity.guide: Info useful for doing it together: place, duration, options. Keep it practical.

REQUEST·activity.label: Asking you to do something
REQUEST·activity.def: do or change something as the sender asks (request, advice)
REQUEST·activity.cues: second person + imperative/advice (你…吧, 记得, 少…, you should)
REQUEST·activity.guide: What the sender asks + the evidence in the content that backs it.

REQUEST·opinion.label: Asking your opinion
REQUEST·opinion.def: give the sender an opinion or answer
REQUEST·opinion.cues: question, opinion-seeking verbs (你觉得, 怎么样, thoughts?)
REQUEST·opinion.guide: The point the sender wants an opinion on + where the content discusses it.

SUGGEST·activity.label: Suggesting you try
SUGGEST·activity.def: try something on their own; free to ignore
SUGGEST·activity.cues: evaluative words implying 'you'd like it' (蛮好喝的, 推荐, so good)
SUGGEST·activity.guide: How to try it: what to order, where.

COMMIT·activity.label: Offering to do it
COMMIT·activity.def: know the sender commits to doing something
COMMIT·activity.cues: first-person singular + future + action for the receiver (我帮你, 我来, I'll)
COMMIT·activity.guide: What the sender will do and roughly how long it takes.

REFUSE·activity.label: Declining
REFUSE·activity.def: know the sender declines something, and why
REFUSE·activity.cues: negation of a proposal (不去了, 算了, can't make it)
REFUSE·activity.guide: Where in the content the reason for declining is.

DELIVER·information.label: FYI
DELIVER·information.cues: neutral statement, no request or stance (看到这个, fyi)

DELIVER·opinion.label: Sharing a view
DELIVER·opinion.def: know the sender's view on the content
DELIVER·opinion.cues: stance on the content (说得对, 我同意, agree)
DELIVER·opinion.guide: Which arguments the sender agrees with and where they are.

REMIND·information.label: Reminder
REMIND·information.cues: reminder words + deadline (提醒一下, 别忘了, 截止)
REMIND·information.guide: The deadline and what to do.

AMEND·information.label: Correction
AMEND·information.cues: correction words (发错了, 更正, 新版本, ignore the last one)
AMEND·information.guide: What changed compared with the earlier version.

EXPRESS·reaction.label: Sharing a moment
EXPRESS·reaction.cues: exclamation, laughter, emoji only (哈哈, lol, 😭)
EXPRESS·reaction.guide: At most 12 words naming the moment.

EXPRESS·attitude.label: Saying thanks
EXPRESS·attitude.def: receive thanks, an apology or congratulations
EXPRESS·attitude.cues: thank/sorry/congrats verbs (谢谢, 抱歉, 恭喜)

GREET.label: Greeting
GREET.def: receive a greeting or holiday wish
GREET.cues: greeting formulas (生日快乐, 新年快乐, happy birthday)
GREET.guide: No summary: return an empty string.

DECLARE.label: Making it official
DECLARE.cues: status-setting performative (就定为, 从今天起, officially)
DECLARE.guide: At most 12 words: what is now settled.

OTHER.label: Shared a link
OTHER.guide: One overall sentence about the content.
